forged_disc0.what: disc 0's k = 1 accumulator after N terms shifted by M'(0)/gamma_0, which cancels M'(0); the budget still passes, the derivative test fails

float.dzeta_zeros_note: every zero of zeta' with 0 <= Im <= 30 and -1 <= Re <= 4 that mpmath's Newton iteration found from a half-unit grid of starts (float model; the literature value is 2.46316 + 23.29832 i)

grid.note: row-major, Im outer / Re inner; value = round(100 log10 |.|), clipped at +-400; the pole s = 1 is stored as +400

float.trust: float model (mpmath, 20 digits), not a certificate; the certificate is the kernel check in SpeiserDerivBox.lean, whose exact numbers are in the `exact` half

note: conjecture1_proved = False. NOT the Speiser wall: Speiser (1935) makes zeta' zero-free on the whole open strip 0 < Re s < 1/2 equivalent to RH; one box decides nothing, and this theorem says nothing about zeros of zeta. The `exact` half is the generator's own arithmetic; the `float` half is an mpmath picture.
